parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `ProcessInfo.ThermalState.description` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` — carries `is_sample_app: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a sample-app-marked record must default to no-action, because lifting the production record (`PerformanceControls.thermalStateLabel` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/DebugUI/ThemeDebugOverlay/PerformanceControls.swift`) into shared code would couple production semantics to sample-app demonstration code. There is no evidence in the cluster row that the sample-app record is a removable prototype rather than a deliberate debug fixture, so the restraint marker is treated as load-bearing.
